environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. No WAF attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with no reverse proxy filtering. SQLite database file is on local EBS volume. HMAC_KEY environment variable set but token signature verification is not implemented in application code (comment says 'delegated to upstream service mesh' but no mesh is deployed).
